limitations: This is visual-layout, retained-product integrity and canonical-arithmetic evidence, not independent physical validation.
Both issues retain incomplete documentation and explicitly missing exact-pair sensitivity. Successful rendering does not supply that evidence.
R2 proposed model remains Unassessed; R1 qualification is restricted to its retained exact tested synthetic scope.
Original synthetic input only. This does not complete the blocked private architectural benchmark.
The generating CLI identity is distinct from installed desktop candidate, installer and hosted CI identities. No native interaction or clean-machine claim is made here.
No simulations or Typst renders occurred during this audit; Poppler rendered already-frozen PDFs for inspection.
The receipt covers these exact frozen products. Subsequent application changes inherit no new visual or engine acceptance automatically. Exact byte reuse may refer back to these product hashes.
Deterministic regeneration and cold-operation evidence are recorded separately by the release collector; this receipt only verifies retained/copy byte equality.
